name: Kerala
intro: Kerala lies along India's rain-soaked south-west coast, where rice is at the centre of the plate and the grandest meal is served on a leaf.

carries.title: The sadya
carries.text: A vegetarian feast of rice with many accompaniments, served on a plantain leaf. The tapering end of the leaf points to the guest's left. The sadya served on Thiruvonam, the most auspicious day of Onam, is the Onasadya.

carries.title: Kept on palm leaves
carries.text: Long before paper was common, texts were written on palm leaves. A sixteenth-century Bhagavad Gita in Malayalam script survives in this form.
